_doc: OPS GitHub App manifest (routing, state, labels, merging) used by `squadhq init --create-app`. The coding agents use a second, narrower App: app-manifest-agent.json. Manifest flow: https://docs.github.com/apps/sharing-github-apps/registering-a-github-app-from-a-manifest. Keys starting with '_' are stripped before posting. Placeholders: __APP_NAME__ (default '<org>-squad'; the agent App defaults to '<org>-squad-agent'), __HUB_URL__, __REDIRECT_URL__ (the localhost callback init spins up), __WEBHOOK_URL__ (server mode only; Actions mode keeps the hook inactive).

_permissions_rationale.contents: write: Agents push feature branches and commit to the hub (state/usage.json, config/projects.json on onboarding). Never pushes to protected default branches: the ruleset requires a PR.
_permissions_rationale.pull_requests: write: Post the merge-policy approval review and arm auto-merge when squadhq.merge_policy passes (risk_based/auto modes); the ruleset's one required approval comes from this App, never from the agent App that pushed the code.
_permissions_rationale.issues: write: Create/label/comment tickets, escalations, daily briefs and onboarding audit issues; create labels from config/flows.yml.
_permissions_rationale.workflows: write: Onboarding seeds .github/workflows/agents.yml in each project and stub-sync keeps it current; GitHub refuses any push touching .github/workflows without this.
_permissions_rationale.actions: write: Re-run failed jobs (failure_handler), dispatch workflows (router -> hub loops), cancel superseded runs.
_permissions_rationale.actions_variables: write: resolve_model reads and deletes one-shot MODEL_OVERRIDE_<JOB> repository variables after a model-specific failure.
_permissions_rationale.checks: read: ci-gate and the merge policy read check-run conclusions before merging.
_permissions_rationale.statuses: read: Same as checks for repos whose CI reports commit statuses instead of check runs.
_permissions_rationale.metadata: read: Mandatory for every GitHub App (repository listing, default branch).
_permissions_rationale.members: read: Resolve team approvers such as @acme/leads to decide who may approve merges or trigger jobs.
_permissions_rationale.organization_projects: write: OPTIONAL: board_sync moves tickets on the org Projects board. Delete this line if you do not use a board.
_permissions_rationale.not requested: administration, secrets, environments, deployments, packages, pages, security_events: never needed by the agents. Rulesets and secrets are applied by `squadhq init` with YOUR gh login, not the App.

name: __APP_NAME__
description: Agent Squad HQ ops identity: routing, state, labels and policy-approved merges. Coding agents use the separate agent App.
